action.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN g.period='2026-04' THEN g.credit-g.debit ELSE 0 END) AS apr_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN g.period='2026-05' THEN g.credit-g.debit ELSE 0 END) AS may_rev FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id=g.account_id WHERE a.type='Revenue' AND g.entity_id='US01' AND g.period IN ('2026-04','2026-05')) SELECT apr_rev, may_rev, ROUND((may_rev-apr_rev)*100.0/NULLIF(apr_rev,0),2) AS pct_change FROM r
